fills: example prompts in the Agent Prompt Guide
formula: each prompt starts 'Create a <component or section>:'
then fills and text as var(--…) pairs, type roles, radius and padding as var(--…), contents
rules: var(--…) names only for colors, radius and spacing
at least one prompt per supplied prompt input
at least one prompt names an occasion component exactly

prompts: Create a Kiln slot card: var(--immersive-palette-50) fill with var(--immersive-on-palette-50) text, var(--borderRadius-400) corners, var(--space-3) padding, the slot time in title3 and one main action on var(--immersive-action) with var(--immersive-on-action) label.
